The '''father''' of [[Kira Carsen]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He and [[Kira Carsen's mother|his wife]] had their child on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], but as a young child Kira was taken by the servants of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] to become one of the [[Children of the Emperor]].
